ABOUT US

Sieve is a multimodal data lab building high-quality training datasets and evaluation environments for frontier AI across audiovisual modeling, robotics, and multimodal interaction. We pair exabyte-scale data infrastructure and global data collection operations with multimodal research to help machines learn how the world looks, sounds, moves, and responds. Our work spans real and virtual environments, from large-scale video and audio to human demonstrations and evaluations of reasoning and action. We believe data creation deserves the same rigor as model development, and that a close connection between data production, model training, and evaluation is essential to building AI that can understand and interact with the world.

We partner with top AI labs and did $XXM last quarter alone, as a team of ~45 people. We also raised our Series A from Tier 1 firms such as Matrix Partners https://matrix.vc/, Swift Ventures https://www.swift.vc/, Y Combinator https://www.ycombinator.com/, and AI Grant https://aigrant.com/.



WHY NOW

Building the next generation of AI requires capturing data from the real world. We're expanding our hardware deployments across countries and need engineers who can get on the ground, figure things out, and make new sites work. You'll join early, own problems end-to-end, and help build the technical foundation for our international operations.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

As an infrastructure engineer at Sieve https://www.sievedata.com/, you’ll design and engineer systems that handle the compute, scheduling, and orchestration of complex ML + ETL pipelines that need to run quickly, reliably, and cost-effectively on large sums of video. 

You’re likely a good fit if you love optimizing for system uptime, have worked with cloud technologies, optimizing hyper-fast distributed systems at the scale of thousands of GPUs, and building great internal tooling and CI/CD for rapid iteration. 




REQUIREMENTS

 - 3+ years of experience building foundational data infrastructure

 - Proficient in working across diverse cloud architectures

 - Designed and maintained pipelines that process petabytes of data

 - Developed robust CI/CD pipelines tailored for ML-focused teams

 - Strong coding experience with Go and Python; Experience with Rust is a plus

 - Operates as an IC who leads by example

 - Experience with large-scale video data systems

 - In-person at our SF HQ




BENEFITS

 - 401k + Full Health Insurance

 - Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner covered and your choice of snacks

 - Ubers covered home



*all roles at Sieve require you to be onsite in San Francisco 5 days per week
